signals.rationale: 1/4 indicators bullish (SLMA only) after a ~27.6% rally from $62.9k to a 30-day high of $80.3k; price has pulled back ~3.6% to $77.4k with SMA7, MACD and Bollinger all reading bearish. Reads as a short-term pullback inside an intact uptrend (golden-cross still holding), not a reversal -- moderate bearish lean, not high conviction.
Identical pattern to BTC: 1/4 bullish (SLMA only), ~34.7% rally to a $2,515 high then a ~3.9% pullback to $2,417.67. Same pullback-in-an-uptrend read as BTC.

Strongest technical picture of the three: 2/4 bullish (SLMA and MACD), vs BTC/ETH's 1/4. Sharpest rally (~48.5% to a $109.18 high) and sharpest pullback since (~8.4% to $99.97), but MACD turning bullish is a real positive divergence from the other two. Close to neutral -- not enough to call bullish outright, but clearly less bearish than BTC/ETH.
